race.comment: DON'T DOUBT DARCY (3) resumes as the horse with the clearest exposed race substance, having been sent out favourite on debut at Kembla Grange before finishing fourth behind Hinzel after covering ground in the run. His recent easy Warwick Farm trial win points to a more settled return and looks well placed to break through. BUSY BEE (4) has race fitness and a reliable maiden profile, with two placings from three starts and a wet-track record that reads well for these conditions. Extra trip in her favour. VERANDERS (8) is an interesting debutant by Anders out of Vee from the Beer and Carpenter yard. Won his latest trial at Kembla Grange, and the family page carries weight through Miss Freelove, a Listed winner and Group-placed relation. Respect. REGAL PROFIT (7) is a Capitalist colt from Still Reigning on debut for the Portelli yard. Has trialled four times, winning three of them, and brings a professional grounding that gives him a genuine hope. The chances don't end there.
